goals.objective: Strictly complete the wise-combine-test final verification wave on the frozen current tree. F1 plan compliance must produce final-f1.md; F2 sanitizer and code-quality audit must produce final-f2.log; F3 real CLI manual QA plus F4 scope-fidelity audit must produce final-f3.md and final-f4.md. Preserve AGENTS.md, do not change product behavior unless a criterion-cited blocker is found, and stop only after all four artifacts pass, cleanup receipts exist, and the plan checkboxes are complete.

successCriteria.scenario: Run git diff --check, inspect AGENTS.md and .omo/plans/wise-combine-test.md, and map every mandatory requirement to source, tests, README, or evidence. PASS iff final-f1.md contains a zero-unresolved checklist and explicitly excludes forbidden parameter-sweeping, GUI, network, and distributed features.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/evidence/wise-combine-test/final-f1.md current-tree re-audit for d520342/ae7de11: all mandatory mappings, relation-flow repair, and forbidden-scope scan pass @tree:ae7de11 | cleanup: no QA processes/ports; temporary paths absent

successCriteria.scenario: Run cmake --build build-asan --parallel and (cd build-asan && ctest --output-on-failure), then inspect all changed source and the sanitizer output for unchecked errors, unsafe default invocation, leaks, out-of-bounds access, and nondeterminism. PASS iff the build and all tests exit 0 and final-f2.log has no criterion-cited blocker.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/evidence/wise-combine-test/final-f2.log current-tree rerun for d520342/ae7de11: ASan/UBSan/LSan build rc=0, 19/19 CTest pass including runtime_argument_relation, no diagnostics @tree:ae7de11 | cleanup: /tmp/wise-final-f2.okOvaZ.log absent; no processes

successCriteria.scenario: Run the exact Linux CLI matrix: validate tests/integration/state_workflow.json; generate tests/integration/relation_workflow.json; run with adapter_ok; run with adapter_mismatch; validate tests/fixtures/invalid.json; run the timeout and crash runtime fixtures; and report a generated TXT report. Then inspect JSON/TXT reports and measurement fields, and grep the final tree for forbidden surfaces. PASS iff documented exit codes/artifacts match and final-f3.md plus final-f4.md include cleanup receipts and zero scope violations.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/evidence/wise-combine-test/final-f3.md and final-f4.md on tree:ae7de11: current CLI matrix passed validate/generate/run/report, mismatch=4, invalid=2, relation injection is observable, forbidden scan had no matches, and old F4 RED was re-audited PASS | cleanup: /tmp/wise-final-f3.emvEKb, /tmp/wise-relation-final.ir1wbM, and /tmp/wise-final-f2.okOvaZ.log absent; no processes remain
